m9z_next.purpose: Extend the payoff-decoupling research from canonical M15 to GOLD M5/H1/H4 using timeframe-specific entry-location and profit-management logic while all fresh forward monitors continue unchanged.
required_per_timeframe: Rebuild the frozen M9S branch candidate population without changing its branch definition.
Measure entry-to-native-exit MAE/MFE, holding time and loss-tail structure.
Measure post-native-exit MFE at causal horizons appropriate to the branch timeframe.
Test whether deep unresolved pullback is weaker than reclaim/confirmation entry; do not copy M15 0.10 ATR / 10m parameters blindly.
Test a small predefined neighborhood of causal reclaim/confirmation rules, seeking a stable family rather than a historical best cell.
Test separate profit-management vectors using higher-timeframe momentum/structure and runner logic appropriate to that branch.
Enforce one-position accounting and quantify overlaps with M15/M9Y and other timeframe branches.
Report count/month, WR, PF, avg win/loss, payoff ratio, DD, max losing streak, loss tails, year/quarter/month behavior and +0.5/+1/+1.5/+2bps sensitivity.
portfolio_after_branch_research: Rebuild a deduplicated GOLD portfolio using only branch families that show broad robustness.
Use multi-timeframe confirmation primarily for position management/confidence, not automatic pyramiding.
Measure incremental value and correlation of each added branch.
Do not modify M9V/M9Y with any M9Z historical finding until a separate deterministic reproduction and future prospective contract are completed.
m9z_next.btc_policy: Keep BTC as a separate research family. Do not transplant GOLD M9Z rules. Continue collecting genuine-source/M7C/M8C evidence; BTC-specific payoff research requires BTC-specific evidence/data.

monitoring_duration_policy.policy: Keep forward loops running through frozen review checkpoints and manually review at the first operational gate before deciding whether further collection is justified.
monitoring_duration_policy.M7C: 5 / 15 / formal >=30 supported events plus ticker/direction/exit minimums.
monitoring_duration_policy.M9V: accepted arm events 20 / 60 / 120 and H1 S3>=10.
monitoring_duration_policy.M9Y: Y0 accepted 20 / 60 / 120 and N6 flagged entries>=10.

tasks: Begin assistant-side M9Z with GOLD M5 branch first, then H1, then H4.
Do not ask the user to run a BAT until a deterministic reproduction or fresh prospective stage actually requires it.
At any forward operational checkpoint, pause historical expansion long enough to review fresh evidence before deciding continuation/promotion.
After forced reboot use only the dedicated recovery BAT; never rerun frozen initializers.
